note: Dry runs: read-only, stop at the proposal. Run them from a project whose upbase/ups/ holds UpS's data (copy examples/ups/ there). Figma Desktop needs the Desktop Bridge open in UpS Product 2026 and one unregistered product file.

evals.name: proposal-mode-stops
evals.prompt: Kho hàng 01 (danh sách kho) in UpS Product 2026 looks dated. Can you make a better version of it? https://www.figma.com/design/9FAdrUvuA7q0VExwsAxNu6/UpS-Product-2026
assertions: Identified UpS Product 2026 by key and read upbase/ups/product-file.md and kit-usage.md
Chose Proposal mode (not Rebuild) and read proposal-mode.md
Found the existing faithful rebuild of Kho hàng 01 in the screen register before planning
Posted a proposal using only existing kit components and stopped for approval; nothing created in Figma

evals.name: unregistered-product-stops
evals.prompt: rebuild the home page hero from our reference — https://www.figma.com/design/iYyuZdlgy1QcEHKgApQXRj/UpBeauty-Website-2026
assertions: Found no product data file for iYyuZdlgy1QcEHKgApQXRj
Stopped and offered to register the product (and its kit map) from _shared/product-template/
Did not use UpS's data, ids or harvested tokens
Created or modified nothing in Figma

evals.name: component-change-handed-off
evals.prompt: On UpS Product 2026 the GridTable needs a 'Sticky header' toggle so the header stays visible when scrolling. Add that to GridTable.
assertions: Recognised this is a change to a kit component, not screen work
Handed it to ui-kit-builder (with a proposal or gap-log entry) instead of building it in the product file
Did not hand-draw or detach anything in the product file
Created or modified nothing in Figma
